import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1000;
    static int N, M;
    static int[][] cap;
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] gr;
    static boolean[] vis;
    static int[] parent;
    static int[][] ds = {{1,0},{0,1},{-1,0},{0,-1}};

    static int augment(int u) {
        if (u == 1) return INF;
        vis[u] = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < gr[u].size(); i++) {
            int v = gr[u].get(i);
            if (!vis[v] && cap[u][v] > 0) {
                int r = augment(v);
                if (r > 0) {
                    parent[v] = u;
                    return Math.min(r, cap[u][v]);
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int maxflow() {
        int ans = 0;
        int flow = 0;
        parent[0] = -1;
        do {
            ans += flow;
            for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) vis[i] = false;
            flow = augment(0);
            if (flow == 0) return ans;
            int v = 1;
            while (v != 0) {
                int u = parent[v];
                cap[u][v] -= flow;
                cap[v][u] += flow;
                v = u;
            }
        } while (flow > 0);
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int dim = sc.nextInt();
        int time_to_die = sc.nextInt();
        int maxNodes = 2 * dim * dim + 2;
        cap = new int[maxNodes][maxNodes];
        gr = new ArrayList[maxNodes];
        for (int i = 0; i < maxNodes; i++) {
            gr[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        vis = new boolean[maxNodes];
        parent = new int[maxNodes];

        String[] labsci = new String[dim];
        String[] labcap = new String[dim];
        int[][][] vert = new int[dim][dim][2];
        int malfunc = 0;

        N = 2;
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
            labsci[i] = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < dim; j++) {
                char c = labsci[i].charAt(j);
                if (c >= '1' && c <= '9') {
                    cap[0][N] = c - '0';
                    gr[0].add(N);
                    gr[N].add(0);
                    vert[i][j][0] = N++;
                } else if (c == 'Z') {
                    malfunc = 100 * i + j;
                    // replace 'Z' with 'Y' in the string (but string is immutable, so we need to create new)
                    StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(labsci[i]);
                    sb.setCharAt(j, 'Y');
                    labsci[i] = sb.toString();
                }
            }
        }

        M = N;
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
            labcap[i] = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < dim; j++) {
                char c = labcap[i].charAt(j);
                if (c >= '1' && c <= '9') {
                    cap[M][1] = c - '0';
                    gr[M].add(1);
                    gr[1].add(M);
                    vert[i][j][1] = M++;
                }
            }
        }

        int[][] die = new int[dim][dim];
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(die[i], time_to_die + 1);
        }
        die[malfunc / 100][malfunc % 100] = 0;

        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(malfunc);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int val = q.poll();
            int x = val / 100;
            int y = val % 100;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + ds[d][0];
                int ny = y + ds[d][1];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < dim && ny >= 0 && ny < dim && labsci[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y' && die[nx][ny] > die[x][y] + 1) {
                    die[nx][ny] = die[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(100 * nx + ny);
                }
            }
        }

        int[][] reach = new int[dim][dim];
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < dim; j++) {
                if (labsci[i].charAt(j) >= '1' && labsci[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    for (int ii = 0; ii < dim; ii++) Arrays.fill(reach[ii], time_to_die + 1);
                    reach[i][j] = 0;

                    if (labcap[i].charAt(j) >= '1' && labcap[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                        cap[vert[i][j][0]][vert[i][j][1]] = INF;
                        gr[vert[i][j][0]].add(vert[i][j][1]);
                        gr[vert[i][j][1]].add(vert[i][j][0]);
                    }

                    q.clear();
                    q.add(100 * i + j);
                    while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                        int val = q.poll();
                        int x = val / 100;
                        int y = val % 100;
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                            int nx = x + ds[d][0];
                            int ny = y + ds[d][1];
                            if (nx >= 0 && nx < dim && ny >= 0 && ny < dim && labsci[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y' && reach[nx][ny] > reach[x][y] + 1) {
                                if (labcap[nx].charAt(ny) >= '1' && labcap[nx].charAt(ny) <= '9') {
                                    if (reach[x][y] + 1 <= die[nx][ny]) {
                                        cap[vert[i][j][0]][vert[nx][ny][1]] = INF;
                                        gr[vert[i][j][0]].add(vert[nx][ny][1]);
                                        gr[vert[nx][ny][1]].add(vert[i][j][0]);
                                    }
                                }
                                if (reach[x][y] + 1 < die[nx][ny]) {
                                    reach[nx][ny] = reach[x][y] + 1;
                                    q.add(100 * nx + ny);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(maxflow());
        sc.close();
    }
}
